summary:
S1: Missing channel_basket_id in S1003_20260616_0216_MOBILE.txt blocks dedup

The S1003_20260616_0216_MOBILE.txt file (2026-06-16) is missing the required channel_basket_id column and instead has an unexpected basket_ref column, causing 82 rows to land with a null dedup key; deduplication cannot run for this batch. Additionally, LOC-0517 sales are split across two outlet IDs affecting 251 rows (3.0%); a resend of S1002_20260612_1120_ECOMM.txt overwrote 88 rows, with 3 rows having differing qty/amount; and S1001_20260618_0638_POSFEED.txt posted only 110 rows, 40% below its 7‑day average, arriving 161 minutes late.
